name: Husky - Transferencias Recebidas

steps.description: Submit login form (input#login e o botao Entrar)
Submit TOTP (input#login e o botao Enter na pagina de verificacao)
Extrair todas as transferencias da tabela

all_transfers.script: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('tr.send-money-transactions-table__tr'); const transfers = []; const cleanClient = (raw) => { if (!raw) return raw; const lines = raw.split(/\n/).map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean); if (!lines.length) return raw.trim(); const noisy = /(Invoices? autom|continuar recebendo|criar as próximas|próximas invoices|Podemos criar|Configura|Você pode alterar)/i; const real = lines.filter(l => !noisy.test(l)); return (real.length ? real[real.length - 1] : lines[lines.length - 1]).trim(); }; rows.forEach(row => { const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td'); if (cells.length >= 4) { const status = cells[0]?.textContent?.trim(); const date = cells[1]?.textContent?.trim(); const clientCell = cells[2]?.querySelector('.send-money-transactions-table__name, [class*="client-name"], [class*="customer-name"]')?.textContent?.trim() || cells[2]?.textContent || ''; const client = cleanClient(clientCell); const localAmount = cells[3]?.querySelector('.send-money-currency__local')?.textContent?.trim(); const foreignAmount = cells[3]?.querySelector('.send-money-currency__foreign')?.textContent?.trim(); const detailLink = cells[4]?.querySelector('a')?.href; const idMatch = detailLink?.match(/transferencias\/(\d+)/); transfers.push({ status, date, client, brl_amount: localAmount, foreign_amount: foreignAmount, husky_id: idMatch ? idMatch[1] : null, detail_url: detailLink }); } }); return JSON.stringify(transfers); })()

notes: Login form: form#new_user, input#user_email, input#user_password, input#login[type=submit]
Login submit: input[type=submit] (NAO e button, e input#login com value='Entrar')
TOTP via 1Password: op item get Husky --otp --vault FinanApp
Pagina TOTP: form#edit_user.mfa-auth-form, input#user_otp_attempt, input#login[type=submit value=Enter]
TOTP submit: input#login[type=submit] com value='Enter' (mesma estrutura do login)
Transfers page: /transferencias com tabela paginada (8 por pagina)
Sem reCAPTCHA - headless Chromium OK (requires_chrome: false)
